goal: Improve marking fairly without losing method credit for alternative working, inflating scores or inventing official scheme provenance.
changes: Allow substantial, explicitly editorial-vetted phrase alternatives only for individual original-practice mark criteria; source-verified strict evidence rules retain priority.
Show numeric point weights and alternative valid phrasings directly in the marking-scheme review.
Show question-specific error-carried-forward method guidance, with no automatic award solely because an earlier error occurred.
Include alternative phrases and ECF guidance in the free manual ChatGPT marking hand-off; no paid API calls.
Warn explicitly when a manual total-score override disagrees with the checked mark-point criteria; do not silently claim missing points were awarded.
Block explicitly negated curated alternatives, reject single-word/number shortcuts.

Local OCR/transcription suggestions may recognise the same vetted alternatives after transcript review, unless arithmetic inconsistency or restrictive evidence rules apply; all marks remain provisional.
A conservative automatic cap is now visibly distinguished from an actual user-selected manual score override.

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.ecfGuidance: If the student has an earlier arithmetic slip but clearly subtracts their own total bond-formation energy from bond-breaking energy, consider the subtraction method separately from the numerical ΔH result.

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.ecfGuidance: If a mistaken extrapolated temperature is carried consistently into ΔT and q=mcΔT, credit separately demonstrated formula/substitution steps where appropriate, not the independent correct-value points.

questions.subject: Physics
questions.ecfGuidance: For the two current calculations, recognise a demonstrated E/(R+r) setup using the student's own preceding internal-resistance value. Award the method only where the substitution is shown; do not automatically award the correct-result point.

questions.subject: Physics
questions.ecfGuidance: A correctly shown f=v/λ using a student's earlier speed or wavelength can receive method consideration, while the separate accurate numerical answer remains conditional on its result.

questions.subject: Maths
questions.ecfGuidance: If an earlier transformed coordinate is incorrect, consider whether later coordinate-transformation operations were applied correctly to that earlier value. Do not award independent correct-coordinate points without evidence.

questions.subject: Maths
questions.ecfGuidance: The first-derivative sign-change test is an equally valid classification method; the second-derivative step is a separate criterion and should not be invented when it is absent.

questions.subject: Maths
questions.ecfGuidance: Method marks for an integral setup or signed-area split can be awarded if demonstrated, even when an earlier arithmetic error affects a later value. Correct final-area marks still require a valid result.

questions.subject: Maths
questions.ecfGuidance: If a student's algebraic inverse method is correct but an earlier rearrangement contained an arithmetic slip, review method evidence separately rather than automatically accepting the incorrect inverse formula.

preserved: All question IDs, prompts, numeric results, point totals and original mark-point text
All deck card IDs and revision history
cautions: Original exam-style practice criteria are not official published AQA mark schemes.
Accepted examples are non-exhaustive; other valid but unlisted methods still require manual correction.
Automatic transcription and OCR cannot fully judge handwriting, diagrams, intermediate steps or errors carried forward.
A correct final value must not imply separate explanation, diagram or proof marks.
Individual quoted alternate phrases are checked semantically for the specified question and require sufficient text, not loose word overlap.
